title: Serum sodium–potassium coupling failed to improve cross-cycle cognitive-score prediction
abstract: In NHANES2011–12 training (n=1172) and2013–14 testing (n=1391) among adults60+, adding a standardized serum sodium×potassium term to a flexible electrolyte/demographic baseline changed weighted DSST MSE from 163.791368 to 164.663023. Baseline-minus-augmented MSE was -0.871655 (paired target-PSU95%CI -1.584145 to -0.040405); incremental benefit was not established.
